connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package rclone-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rclone-ui account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
